title: Food Is Medicine In Survivorship (Foodiis-AYA): Examining The Feasibility And Acceptability Of A Remotely-Delivered Meal Kit And Culinary Medicine Program For Survivors Of Adolescent/Young Adult (AYA) Cancer
official: Food Is Medicine In Survivorship (Foodiis-AYA): Examining The Feasibility And Acceptability Of A Remotely-Delivered Meal Kit And Culinary Medicine Program For Survivors Of Adolescent/Young Adult (AYA) Cancer
summary: To study the feasibility of a new nutritional intervention (Food is Medicine in Survivorship - Adolescents / Young Adults \[FoodiiSAYA\]) for patients 18-25 years old who have completed cancer treatment.
criteria:
Eligibility Criteria

* Currently aged 18-25 years
* History of cancer diagnosed between the ages of 15-25
* Have completed active cancer treatment (chemotherapy, radiation, immunotherapy, surgery)
* Self-report having internet access.
* Self-report as being able to speak and read English.
* Self-report having access to a kitchen and refrigerator
* Willing to complete study assessments.

Exclusion Criteria

* Individuals under 18 or over 25 years old at the time of study enrollment
* Currently undergoing active cancer treatment for recurrent or new primary cancer
